forbidden.name: entry-imports
forbidden.comment: An entry file imports only a feature's or a client's index.ts. Put the logic in src/features/<name>/.

forbidden.name: feature-imports
forbidden.comment: A feature imports its own files, another feature's or a client's index.ts, and src/primitives/. Move shared code to src/primitives/ or behind an index.ts.

forbidden.name: client-imports
forbidden.comment: A client imports its own files, another client's index.ts, and src/primitives/. Call a client from a feature, never a feature from a client.

forbidden.name: primitives-imports
forbidden.comment: src/primitives/ knows no feature and no client. Move code that needs one into that feature or client.

forbidden.name: test-code-imports
forbidden.comment: Test code imports its own folder, index.ts files, src/primitives/ and tools/driver/index.ts.

forbidden.name: production-imports-test-code
forbidden.comment: Production code never imports a test, a fixture, a scenario or the PHI eval corpus.

forbidden.name: tools-imports
forbidden.comment: Dev tooling imports the harness only through a feature's or a client's index.ts or src/primitives/.

forbidden.name: no-scenario-imports
forbidden.comment: Nothing imports a scenario. Run it with bun <file>.
